headline: Germany and Kenya Launch Labor Mobility Program for Hospitality Workers
summary: Thirty-three Kenyan youths were selected to begin vocational training connected to employment opportunities in Germany's hospitality sector. The initiative stems from a bilateral labor mobility pact between the two governments.
why: Bilateral labor mobility treaties help European nations address domestic workforce shortages while providing employment pathways for emerging market workers.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Overseas employment opportunities provide skilled training and future remittance flows.
